scope: One explicitly selected actor across an immutable hash-pinned local source set. No runtime/DB production importer, memory backfill or SFT/DPO curation.

sourceManifest.paths: Relative local JSONL files below manifest directory; no URLs, traversal, symlinks or nonregular files. Raw manifest SHA required on every action.

virtualJsonl: Hash each source in declared order, appending LF only to nonempty sources lacking a terminal LF. Empty files contribute no bytes. Existing local-owner-jsonl artifact SHA identifies this exact virtual JSONL; outer envelope additionally binds the raw source-manifest SHA and individual hashes/bytes.

checkpoint.storage: Dedicated Gitignored .sites-runtime/training/<job>/state.sqlite, owner-only files; application_id/schema identity; no world DB. SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE/FULL sync commits admitted rows, dedup/legacy ledger, counters, byte+line cursor and final artifact together.
checkpoint.compareAndSwap: Initial --expected-checkpoint=new; resume requires last reported checkpoint SHA. Header checksum includes all admitted canonical rows/ledger. Status is read-only and exposes only hashes/counts/cursor.
checkpoint.batchFailure: Invalid JSON/UTF8/record, strong/weak identity conflict, reused sample, temporal fork, changed source, over-budget or fault rolls back entire current batch. Earlier committed batches remain. CLI emits a line after each commit so later failure does not hide accepted progress.
checkpoint.crash: Kernel/SQLite transaction rollback; no user PID lease or forced stale-lock deletion. Status may need normal run recovery if a killed writer left a hot journal.
checkpoint.training: Do not fit per batch. Only fit once after the entire source set has been accepted, in the same global chronological/curriculum order as single-file replay. Final model and final cursor share one transaction.
checkpoint.export: Separate action, private JSON staged+fsynced then published via same-directory exclusive hard link. Current source/head verified; output collision/failure never changes checkpoint or exposes a partial JSON.
checkpoint.compatibility: Marker and checkpoint pin current replay/reward/feature versions and scenario signature; changed processor compatibility cannot silently resume.

privacy: Actor filter before audit or storage. Foreign raw records never enter the checkpoint.
Only accepted numeric/canonical evidence and bounded unverified-ID ledger are stored privately; no source dialogue/memory fields copied.
Console/errors expose no actor IDs, raw records or source paths. SHA integrity is not external authenticity.
verification: Same report/acceptedDigest/model rows and complete artifact as single-file replay on exact virtual concatenation.
Cross-file duplicates/conflicts, legacy/strong collision both orders, actor filter, temporal neighbor checks and Unicode/CRLF/no-final-newline/empty files.
Resume/complete retries, stale SHA/concurrent writer, crash/rollback, source/manifest/checkpoint tamper, byte/row/path budgets and failed exclusive export.
Compiled local D1 JSONL -> bulk/cursor -> private export keeps snapshot/history/earned samples unchanged.
Full unit/typecheck/lint/build; verify offline implementation is absent from production Worker.
learningEvidence: Engineering equivalence/transaction tests only; no new policy candidates, holdout reads, training-benefit claims or reward/features changes.
nextSeparateWork: Additive historical memory backfill with checkpoint/CAS/ID reconciliation.
Dataset/few-shot/SFT/DPO curation with same prompt/context/model and real validators.
